inlines.v: SAF'FLOW, SAF'FLOWER, noun The plant, bastard saffron, of the genus Carthamus. SAF'FLOWER, noun A deep red fecula separated from orange-colored flowers, particularly those of the Carthamustinctorius; called also Spanish red and China lake. The dried flowers of the Carthamustinctorius.
